purpose: Complete the previously frozen native-token matrix after interruption, retaining original samples and adding an output-equivalent performance optimization.
optimization: Use tiktoken 0.12.0 encode_with_unstable to reuse only tokenizer-certified stable prefix tokens, and re-encode the remaining tail together with every appended candidate. Never add separately counted prefix and suffix token lengths.

A first-choice success uses one ordinary full-context encode. Stable-prefix enumeration is prepared lazily only after the first rejection when several candidates remain, avoiding setup work on short or immediately successful lists.
Reuse exact rendered-text term sets only inside one assemble call. No persistent source-text cache or cross-request state is introduced.
Keep candidate order, 96-unit bound, character/token caps, source coordinates, baseline block preservation, and all selection rules unchanged.

development_validation.gate: All 2016 complete result payload hashes must match the previous native implementation, excluding only latency_ms. Both workers must retain unchanged runtime sources. Source texts are not published.
development_validation.timing: Sequential isolated worker processes on the same host, tokenizers initialized before measured calls; report all configuration p50/p95/mean. One pass is a development timing diagnostic, not a robust production latency guarantee.
development_validation.preserved_initial_attempt: benchmarks/reports/native-optimization-development.json.gz (initial eager prefix setup; all 2016 payloads match but some wall-clock tails regress)
development_validation.final_attempt: benchmarks/reports/native-optimization-lazy-development.json.gz (same 2016 comparisons after lazy prefix setup; source hashes identify each implementation)

unchanged_from_original: native old-block preservation and source/budget gates
final_protocol.candidate_snapshot: .artifacts/native-completion-candidate/src (detached worktree at the newly committed runtime; actual Git/source identity is recorded in every worker report)
final_protocol.preservation: Do not overwrite benchmarks/native-final-manifest.json, native-final-checkpoint.json, or original native-final results. No heldout/external label inspection or parameter adjustment precedes this frozen completion run.

limits: The previously observed synthetic/public datasets are regressions. Hotpot128 is the independently authored frozen external transfer diagnostic; after this run it too becomes regression data. Context evidence scores remain distinct from generated-answer scores and full native competitor workflow costs.
